interactions.description: Vibe Support Case Redacted Evidence boundary returns accepted HOBO-564 evidence

consumedSupportWorkflowMockupRefs.supportCaseUse: case prototype starts from accepted requester, channel, affected surface, and first customer-safe summary
severity and owner route are copied from the accepted triage mockup, not inferred from raw ticket text
redacted logs, incident refs, admin context, docs, and proof package links remain explicit evidence pack fields
support case owner route preserves security, incident, release, docs, and support boundaries
customer update text is gated by redaction state and next update condition
closure cites approved docs, follow-up owner, or unsupported-state explanation without building support runtime

evidencePacks.customerSafeSummary: customer-safe support case summary with redacted deploy log lines and approved docs answer
evidencePacks.adminContext: workspace acme-prod, project launch-demo, environment preview; tenant ids redacted
evidencePacks.nextUpdateCondition: when docs owner approves the final customer-safe answer

evidencePacks.customerSafeSummary: redacted incident-adjacent context without responder-only notes or raw diagnostic payloads
evidencePacks.adminContext: affected launch-demo project and environment only; no customer payloads or secrets
evidencePacks.nextUpdateCondition: after incident commander confirms customer-visible impact and approved wording

evidencePacks.customerSafeSummary: customer-safe stale evidence update that points to limitation wording instead of a launch claim
evidencePacks.adminContext: workspace acme-prod, plan review snapshot, freshness state stale; customer identifiers redacted
evidencePacks.nextUpdateCondition: once release owner accepts limitation wording or refreshes the proof fixture

evidencePacks.customerSafeSummary: customer-safe scope-out raw data request routed without raw disclosure or support impersonation
evidencePacks.adminContext: raw tenant data request withheld; support can see route, not payload
evidencePacks.nextUpdateCondition: before any customer-visible evidence leaves security and legal review

scenarioPaths.narrative: A customer-safe support case links redacted deploy logs, approved docs, support references, and proof evidence before closure.
scenarioPaths.safeOutcome: customer receives approved docs answer and redacted proof references without raw evidence exposure

scenarioPaths.narrative: A raw customer-data request is routed to security/legal and remains scope-out until approval exists.
scenarioPaths.safeOutcome: support records the owner route and next update condition instead of granting data access

scenarioPaths.narrative: A stale proof fixture produces limitation wording and a refresh owner instead of an unsupported readiness claim.
scenarioPaths.safeOutcome: support states stale evidence and routes refresh work before claiming launch readiness

scenarioPaths.narrative: Incident-adjacent context is handed to Incident Communications with redacted support references and customer-safe boundaries.
scenarioPaths.safeOutcome: support handoff preserves incident owner routing, redaction state, and next customer update condition

accessibilityNotes: Keyboard order moves from case summary to severity, redaction state, evidence pack, owner route, and next update condition.
Screen reader labels announce proof mode, redaction state, owner route, and whether evidence is customer-safe or internal-only.
Contrast is paired with text labels for blocked, stale, internal-only, and scope-out evidence pack states.
Motion is optional; evidence pack expansion, route changes, and status transitions must respect reduced-motion preferences.
scopeOut: No helpdesk integration or support queue automation.
No customer-data access, support impersonation, tenant browsing, or secret exposure.
No incident command ownership, runbook execution, on-call staffing, or notification dispatch.
No production support UI or support portal implementation.
No contractual SLA promise, paid support term, or public response-time guarantee.
